dataScale.name: occupancy
dataScale.purpose: One hue of night blue, lightness rising, so on night the fullest is the brightest light and every step holds 3:1 on every night ground (the lowest 4.1:1 on night-950, 3.8:1 on night-900, the map's land, and 3.1:1 on night-800; the brightest 15.8:1 on night-950). On white the lowest two hold (4.3:1, 3.1:1) and the two bright steps vanish, so a mark of the scale on white wears a navy ring (--th-occ-ring #213047); better, the scale lives on night. A light is a solid dot in its class's colour with a soft halo of the same colour, added to its neighbours'. A listing with no figure is an empty mist-dim ring.

display.purpose: The first screen's headline only, three lines, 300 at -0.03em, mist but for "Plot" and "sights" in ink (the name read out of it); sized as (min(100vw, 1440px) - 2 * gutter) * 0.42 / 10.85 so "Insights backed by data." fits the 42% column, at most 56px. Each line rises out of a mask in the opening.

intro.purpose: "Backed by data." and "Market intelligence, three ways.", the headings that open "How it works" and the products: 32 to 56px, 300, two-tone.

headline.purpose: --th-heading: a product chapter's name and claim: 32 to 44px, 300, two-tone.

close.purpose: "Ask the team." on the close's night card: 40 to 64px, 300.

figure.purpose: --th-text-figure: the tipping point and the database's counts; 300, tabular, -0.04em. Never counted up.

lead.purpose: --th-text-lead: the hero's two-tier sentence and the close's sentence; 300 from 641px, 400 on a phone.

title.purpose: The tipping point's question, a stop on the How line: 20px, 400.

body.purpose: --th-text-body: running text, the search field, list rows, the bubbles, the bar's links; every action at 500.

small.purpose: --th-text-small: captions, a report's lines, the questions.

fine.purpose: --th-text-fine: the floor (15px). Eyebrows, chart ticks, the map cards, tags, the hero's strip.

eyebrow.purpose: The label over a heading: sentence case, the fine size, 400, +0.01em, in the second tone (mist-ink on white, mist on night). Never tracked capitals.

action.purpose: The label of every pill button: 18px at 500.

wordmark.purpose: Plotsights in the bar, its "o" the plot: 26px, 500, -0.035em.

wordmark-foot.purpose: The name at the close card's full width: 64 to 236px, 400, -0.05em, the plot's line thinned.

sheet-heading.purpose: "Questions." beside the data sheet: 32 to 38px, 300, two-tone.

shadows.name: map-float
shadows.purpose: A map card on night glass over the night map: a faint light rim, an inner highlight, the one soft shadow.

shadows.name: place-list
shadows.purpose: The list of places, night glass floating under the search pill.

shadows.name: report-sheet
shadows.purpose: The report's white sheet raised off its ice tile.

shadows.name: nav-sheet
shadows.purpose: The phone menu's night sheet, open under the bar.

shadows.name: nav-day-hairline
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: the hairline under the day bar's white glass.

shadows.name: field-edge
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: the search pill's 1px light edge (0.5 on hover and focus).

shadows.name: glow-hero
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow: the glow rising behind the town in the hero (falling from the top in the close at 0.7).

shadows.name: glow-card
shadows.purpose: Not a shadow: the glow rising inside every navy card from below.

shadows.name: light-halo
shadows.value: 0 0 6px to 0 0 12px in the light's own colour
shadows.purpose: A light's glow is the data: the key's dots, a card's short-let mark, the tipping point's dot. Nothing else glows.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: --th-ease: the one exponential ease-out, for every transform and every authored moment.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Fill changes on hover and the 0.97 press of a pill; the arrow inside moves 3px over 0.2s.

motion.name: glow-breathe
motion.value: 9s ease-in-out infinite (11s in the close); opacity 0.78 to 1, scale 1 to 1.045
motion.purpose: The glow breathes; still with reduced motion.

motion.name: opening-line-rise
motion.purpose: The opening (first page of a visit only, never with reduced motion): "Pl" and "t" rise, the pointer draws the plot as the "o" (Plot, in ink), then "sights" comes into focus in mist (opening-strike); the name holds and rises to the bar, "sights" turning to ink; the headline's lines rise out of masks with "Plot" and "sights" lit (Opening.tsx).

motion.name: tour-pin
motion.purpose: A map card arriving beside its drawn area; one town leaves west as the next comes from the east (opacity 0.9s, a 3% slide over 1.2s); the window pans 0.7s.

motion.name: stream-word
motion.purpose: The Connector's answer streams; every word is in the page from the start, only opacity waits.

motion.name: sheet-deal
motion.purpose: The report's sheet laid on its tile when the section first arrives.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No opening, no tour beyond its first town, no streaming, no scroll fill, no page slide, a still glow.

motion.name: opening-strike
motion.purpose: The second strike of the opening: "sights" arrives a beat after the plot closes, in the second tone.

motion.name: rv-travel
motion.purpose: Arrivals (data-rv, Reveal.tsx): rise once on arrival; only what is below the window after load is hidden; nothing without script, with reduced motion, or in print.

motion.name: rv-fade
motion.purpose: The opacity half of an arrival; staggers of 80ms, at most six in a run.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: 1200ms ease-out cubic, from 86% of the figure
motion.purpose: The database counts and the island's short-lets count up once, true figures only, tabular; screen readers get the true figure throughout.

motion.name: story-swap
motion.value: scroll-driven per step (in over cover 24-32%, out over 68-76%), 12px rise; 0.6s fade where scroll timelines are missing
motion.purpose: The held frame of "How it works" changes picture with the step at the window's middle.

motion.name: story-scrub
motion.value: scroll-driven within each step: zoom 30-46%, town 39-50%, area drawn 47-56%; match lines 28-38%+
motion.purpose: The island zooms to Kato Paphos and the match lines run out with the scroll from 1024px; elsewhere the same moves play once in time.

breakpoints.name: lg

breakpoints.name: how-line
breakpoints.value: 1100px (64px gutters; the How line runs across)

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.value: 1280px (three map cards pinned beside their areas; the bar's tagline shows)

narrative.overview:
The page is calm, expensive and quiet, a night sky over data: a navy first screen with a soft blue glow rising behind a real Cyprus town, then bands of ice and night inset in a white page, then night again. On the night map every short-let the team reads is a light, its brightness its occupancy this season, so a town's fullest streets glow; an area a few streets wide is drawn on it in ice and answered on a dark glass card for all three markets. That map is the page's one rich thing. Everything else gives it room: thin type in two tones, no saturated colour, navy cards and pale tiles instead of borders, pills for everything you press.

The idea, in the subject's own terms: **on this page, every short-let in a Cyprus town becomes a light on its night map, brighter where it is fuller, and every plot drawn on it is answered for all three markets.** A short-let analytics site shows short-lets only and a listings site shows no occupancy; the three-market card on a hand-drawn plot of a named Cyprus street is this product's own.
keyCharacteristics: A navy night card for the hero and another for the close, inset 12px (8px on a phone) from the white page with 20px corners.
Below the hero the grounds alternate: ice and night bands inset like the hero, white only for the products' tiles and the questions, never two white sections together (owner, 2026-10-17).
One hue of blue for the data, monotone in lightness: on night the fullest is the brightest light.
Google Sans Flex at 300 for every heading and large figure, two-tone (the statement in ink, the payoff in mist or slate blue); 400 for reading; 500 for labels and buttons; nothing bold.
Eyebrows over headings and pills for every button, field, tag and chosen option, as in the reference.
Glass only where something floats: the cards and the list over the night map, the bar once it floats over the white page.

rules.name: Brighter Is Fuller
rules.body: On the night map, a listing's brightness is its occupancy and nothing else: the halos add up, the dots never do.

rules.name: Night Carries Data
rules.body: Live figures sit on night (the hero map, the tipping point, the conversation); paper things sit on pale tiles (the report, the views, the questions). White text never sits on a pale tile.

rules.name: No Saturated Accent
rules.body: The page has no colour outside the navy-to-ice range; emphasis is the second tone of a heading, never a coloured word.

rules.name: The Page Ends In Night
rules.body: The close and the footer share one night card; nothing else after the hero is a night ground but the navy cards.

rules.name: Two Tones, One Face
rules.body: Emphasis is the second tone and the size step; never a second family, never bold.

rules.name: The Floor
rules.body: 15px is the smallest text on the page.

rules.name: Eyebrows Inform
rules.body: An eyebrow says what the section is for in a few words ("Explore it yourself", "Written by the team", "In Claude", "Method", "Contact"); it is sentence case at the fine size in the second tone, never tracked capitals.

rules.name: The Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass only where something floats over something that can be seen through it: the cards pinned on the night map and the list of places (night glass: night-900 at 92%, an 18px blur, a faint light rim and inner highlight), and the bar once it floats over the white page (white at 88%, an 18px blur, a hairline under it). Everything else is solid: the navy cards, the tiles, every button. Without `backdrop-filter`, or with `prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce`, each is its solid fill.

dos: Keep live data on night and paper things on pale tiles.
Set headings and large figures at 300 in two tones.
Show all three markets wherever an area is summed up ("don't mislead the customer", owner, 2026-10-09), and say "Sample data" wherever a figure is demo data.
Give each section one working thing built from real data, usable with a thumb and readable without its script.
donts: Don't add a saturated colour, a coloured word, or bold type.
Don't put glass where nothing floats, or a shadow on anything that neither floats nor lies raised (the map cards, the list, the open menu, the report's sheet are the only ones).
Don't let the map, a light, an area or a card under the words.
Don't use monospace labels, logo tiles, or tracked capitals.
Don't count figures up, or hide content until a scroll or a script.
open: **The Playground** (`/dashboard`) is still direction G; it follows Blue Night later.
The concept's drifting light streaks in the hero were left out (see docs/LANDING.md).
